title: Some AI startups are boosting their valuations by raising capital in back-to-back or multitiered deals, raising questions about how much they are really worth (Angel Au-Yeung/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Angel Au-Yeung / Wall Street Journal: Some AI startups are boosting their valuations by raising capital in back-to-back or multitiered deals, raising questions about how much they are really worth — The race to get into hot AI startups has led to unequal deals for investors, raising questions about how much companies are really worth
